t: This is One Canada Square, the tower at the heart of Canary Wharf. It rises fifty floors and 235 metres, making it the third tallest building in the United Kingdom today. When it was completed in 1991 it was the tallest in the country, and it kept that title for twenty-one years, until The Shard overtook it in 2012. It was designed by César Pelli, the Argentine-American architect, who also designed other towers you can see around you here.
